name: syndroo
description: Open-source publishing infrastructure for the social web.

SYNDROO_API_KEY.description: Choose a long random string. API clients send it as the Syndroo Bearer token.

BLUESKY_PASSWORD.description: A Bluesky app password. Do not use your main account password.

BLUESKY_HOST.description: The Bluesky PDS hostname. Use `bsky.social` for the default service.

THREADS_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: A long-lived Threads user access token with `threads_basic` and `threads_content_publish`.

X_API_KEY.description: Optional: X OAuth 1.0a consumer API key for an app with Read and Write permissions.

X_API_SECRET.description: Optional: X OAuth 1.0a consumer API secret.

X_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional: X OAuth 1.0a user access token, issued after enabling write permissions.

X_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Optional: Secret paired with the X OAuth 1.0a user access token.

TUMBLR_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Optional: Tumblr user OAuth token secret.

TUMBLR_BLOG.description: Optional: Target Tumblr blog name, for example alice (not a URL).

LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional: LinkedIn user access token authorized for publishing.

LINKEDIN_AUTHOR.description: Optional: LinkedIn person or organization URN; one author per deployment.

LINKEDIN_API_VERSION.description: Optional: Explicit supported LinkedIn API version in YYYYMM format.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @syndroo/core && npm run build --workspace @syndroo/bluesky && npm run build --workspace @syndroo/threads && npm run build --workspace @syndroo/linkedin && npm run build --workspace @syndroo/tumblr && npm run build --workspace @syndroo/x
scripts.build:package: npm run build && npm run build:package --workspace @syndroo/cloudflare-worker
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:scripts && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @syndroo/core && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/bluesky && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/threads && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/linkedin && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/tumblr && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/x && npm run test --workspace @syndroo/cloudflare-worker
